Our Specialities

Catering Services

From a fifty-guest family puja to a three-thousand-plate Maharashtrian wedding — cooked fresh on site in Ahilyanagar.

SERVICE 01

Maharashtrian Wedding Banquets

Authentic Maharashtrian wedding feasts including Lagna lunch, Reception dinner, Sangeet & Mehendi counters for 100 to 3,000+ guests. Traditional banana leaf, brass/copper serving or fine buffet setup.

  • ◆ Traditional Maharashtrian Thali (Puran Poli, Modak, Katachi Amti)
  • ◆ Menu tasting session included for the family
  • ◆ Dedicated venue captain & uniformed service team
SERVICE 02

Corporate Dining & Events

Punctual catering for corporate conferences, annual meetings, industrial meets across MIDC Ahilyanagar, and executive lunches with customized Indian & multi-cuisine menus.

  • ◆ Timed service slots with strict punctuality
  • ◆ Maharashtrian, North Indian & Continental options
  • ◆ GST invoicing & corporate billing support
SERVICE 03

Live Cooking Counters

Interactive live food counters where our chefs prepare hot dishes right in front of your guests — Pav Bhaji, Live Dosa, Chaat counter, Tandoor, Pasta & Mocktail bars.

  • ◆ 12+ live counter themes
  • ◆ Trained live chefs with spotless counters
  • ◆ Custom signage and decorative counter styling
SERVICE 04

Vastu Shant, Munj & Religious Pujas

Pure vegetarian traditional meals served for Vastu Shant (Housewarming), Munj (Thread Ceremony), Satyanarayan Puja, and traditional religious events with authentic Maharashtrian items.

  • ◆ From 30 to 500+ guests
  • ◆ Traditional banana leaf or silver plate service
  • ◆ Pure sattvic & fresh venue cooking
SERVICE 05

Celebrations & Sweets Stations

Birthdays, silver jubilees, and family anniversaries styled with curated Maharashtrian sweets tables (Basundi, Jalebi, Shrikhand, Gulab Jamun) and live dessert counters.

  • ◆ Premium dessert spreads & sweets counters
  • ◆ Theme-based decor & table arrangement
  • ◆ Mocktails, starters & late-night snacks
